reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Prometheus scrape configurations or monitoring queries that reference the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` will no longer find that metric; the metric is only available under its new name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total`.
consequence.remediation: Update Prometheus scrape configurations, dashboards, and alerting rules to reference the new metric name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` instead of the old name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count`.

proposed.statement: The Prometheus metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` in Cilium 1.17.0.
